notes: Output FPS counts publications, depth_checks counts stereo probes. In changes mode the projector holds a static map and updates at a limited rate during changes and motion. Motion does not need to stop; published depth is the latest measured frame without temporal trails. A saved work area restricts changes, display reconstruction and exports to the projector footprint. Its homography aligns a flat floor, not elevated 3D relief. Depth checks still run periodically; expensive presentation runs only on publication. Timestamps are software receipt times, not hardware exposure synchronization. Long interactive periods retain the most recent 900 metric samples; depth_checks counts all processed pairs. Uncalibrated disparity cannot establish depth accuracy or compare depth quality. Presentation smoothing and hole interpolation affect only display images/display_depth_m.npy. Small enclosed gaps may briefly retain earlier depth with a static camera image; held pixels remain inferred and their lifetime is not refreshed by holding. Surface completion estimates unobserved regions for presentation only; completed_mask marks these points. It is not a full-field accuracy claim. Live Z, reference checks and depth_m.npy always use original stereo measurements.
